continuity.recovery_rule: Restart from durable state + packet/hash + roster generation + compact progress snapshot, never from raw chat history.

KEEP: storage budget ledger and content-addressed manifest
best verified adapter/checkpoint per promoted specialist
WASTE_CANDIDATE: download/install scratch after verified package/model admission
duplicate model files with identical content hash and no required-format justification
raw training/debug logs after verified compact evidence extraction
duplicate self-reports and one-shot progress files
failed synthetic fixtures reproducible from retained generator/config
temporary merged weights when base+adapter+merge recipe remain reproducible
QUARANTINE: unique failed checkpoint with unresolved value
safety regression sample not yet distilled into verified test

automatic_disposal_guards: reproducible from retained source/config or exact duplicate hash
C verification not pending on the artifact

retention.rule: Keep current candidate plus best verified generation; older generations may be disposed only if reproducible and unreferenced.

phase_transition_cleanup.builder: classify and propose/perform only guard-approved disposal within authorized workspace
phase_transition_cleanup.verifier: independently verify protected survival, manifest consistency, storage ledger delta, and restart recovery
phase_transition_cleanup.after: A absorbs compact verified disposition only; raw worksite does not become durable truth

gearbox_integration.G1: owns brake/fail-closed decisions and storage/safety hard guards
gearbox_integration.G2_G4: may propose disposal or compaction but cannot bypass G1 guards
gearbox_integration.G5_G6: never gain deletion authority merely because they are larger models
gearbox_integration.R: rollback/recovery path; protected from automatic disposal

goal: Maintain wakeful continuity while reducing retained worksite entropy at every verified phase boundary.
